trap.label: estrutura
trap.wrong: She convinced me to sign the contract.
trap.right: She persuaded me to sign the contract.
trap.why: Português “convenceu-me a assinar” usa um só verbo; em inglês convince + that/of (crença) e persuade + to (ação).

mcq.q: She convinced me ___ it was true.

fix.wrong: She persuaded me that it was true.
fix.right: She convinced me that it was true.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com persuade: “She convinced me to sign.”
Reescreva com convince: “She persuaded me that it was true.”
rewrite.answer: She convinced me that it was true.
